title: Tesla cash burn to test investor faith in AI bets
title_zh: 特斯拉烧钱测试投资者对人工智能押注的信心
summary: Tesla is expected to report its first quarterly cash burn in over two years on Wednesday, as its spending on AI and robotics soars, intensifying investor scrutiny over when those bets ‌will pay off.
summary_zh: 特斯拉预计将在周三公布两年多以来的首次季度现金消耗情况，因为其在人工智能和机器人技术上的支出飙升，这将加强投资者对这些押注何时获得回报的审查。

title: Alibaba's Apple tie-up adds fuel to China's hottest ETF: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 阿里巴巴与苹果的合作为中国最热门的 ETF 注入了动力：每日图表
summary: Alibaba is helping power a broad rebound in Chinese internet stocks.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴正在帮助推动中国互联网股票的全面反弹。

title: Stock market today: Nasdaq leads Dow, S&P 500 futures higher as chip stocks revive
title_zh: 今日股市：随着芯片股复苏，纳斯达克指数领先道琼斯指数和标准普尔 500 指数期货走高
summary: Markets weighed new tariffs imposed on Canadian goods, the latest US-Iran escalation, and fresh earnings from General Motors and other companies.
summary_zh: 市场权衡了对加拿大商品征收的新关税、美国与伊朗之间的最新升级，以及通用汽车和其他公司的新盈利。

title: China’s GigaAI Seeks 2026 Hong Kong IPO in First for World Model
title_zh: 中国GigaAI寻求2026年香港IPO，成为世界典范
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Jijia Vision is in discussions to hold an initial public offering on Hong Kong’s stock exchange as soon as this year, joining a flurry of Chinese AI firms planning public market debuts.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——积家视觉正在讨论最快今年在香港证券交易所进行首次公开​​募股，加入众多计划公开市场的中国人工智能公司的行列。

title: Paramount-Warner Deal at Risk of Delays That Would Cost Billions
title_zh: 派拉蒙与华纳的交易面临延误风险，损失数十亿美元
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Paramount Skydance Corp. was on the brink of closing its blockbuster $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——派拉蒙 Skydance 公司即将完成对华纳兄弟探索公司 1100 亿美元的重磅收购。

title: US stocks edge down with Iran and earnings season in focus
title_zh: 美国股市小幅下跌，伊朗和财报季成为焦点
summary: STORY: Stocks started the week on a down note, with the Dow falling about six tenths of one percent, while the S&P 500 dropped two tenths and the Nasdaq ended basically flat.:: ArchiveInvestors looked for moves toward de-escalation in the Middle East while they waited for...
summary_zh: 故事：股市本周开局下跌，道琼斯指数下跌约十分之六百分之一，标准普尔 500 指数下跌十分之二，纳斯达克指数收盘基本持平。：档案投资者在等待...的同时，也在寻找中东局势缓和的举措。

title: US judge approves Anthropic's $1.5 billion settlement of copyright lawsuit
title_zh: 美国法官批准 Anthropic 15 亿美元版权诉讼和解
summary: By Blake Brittain July 20 (Reuters) - A federal judge in San Francisco on Monday signed off on artificial intelligence company Anthropic's landmark $1.5 billion settlement of a class action lawsuit
summary_zh: 作者：Blake Brittain 7 月 20 日（路透社）——周一，旧金山的一名联邦法官签署了人工智能公司 Anthropic 具有里程碑意义的 15 亿美元集体诉讼和解协议

title: AMD sets sights on Nvidia with Helios AI racks
title_zh: AMD 通过 Helios AI 机架瞄准 Nvidia
summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination to discuss AMD (AMD) new Helios AI rack server platform and how the chipmaker is ramping up its challenge to AI leader Nvidia (NVDA).
summary_zh: 雅虎财经科技编辑 Dan Howley 与 Market Domination 一起讨论 AMD (AMD) 新的 Helios AI 机架服务器平台，以及这家芯片制造商如何加大对人工智能领导者 Nvidia (NVDA) 的挑战。

title: AMD stock rises on price target bumps, Microsoft deal
title_zh: AMD 股价因目标价上涨和微软交易而上涨
summary: AMD stock rose more than 3% on Monday.
summary_zh: AMD 股价周一上涨超过 3%。
